definitions.timing_of_matched: the matched pairs; over the matched pairs above: estimated time minus truth time, in seconds (median, mean, mean of the absolute value, 95th percentile of the absolute value, largest absolute value); positive = the estimate is late
definitions.f_measure: mir_eval.onset.f_measure(reference_onsets, estimated_onsets, window=0.05): an estimated onset is a hit when within 0.05 s of a reference onset, each matched once; precision = n_matched/n_est, recall = n_matched/n_truth
